Digital Era

Anti-static lid design for error-free recording
Made in Japan

description:
Pressed Glass Insulator Lot - 12 Pieces
Whitall Tatum, Armstrong, and Pyrex
Aqua, Clear, and Smoky, Vintage 1920s-1950s
This collection features twelve vintage glass telephone and telegraph insulators from prominent American manufacturers. These pieces represent a significant era in telecommunications history, showcasing various industrial glass formulas including standard aqua, clear, and heat-resistant Pyrex borosilicate glass. Matching sets and mixed lots from these manufacturers are highly collectible for their industrial aesthetic and historical utility.
Pieces Included:
Whitall Tatum Co. No. 1, Aqua Glass - characteristic greenish-blue tint, molded manufacturer marks on base
Pyrex Clear Glass Insulator - high-clarity borosilicate glass, marked "Pyrex Reg. U.S. Pat. Off."
Armstrong "W" in Triangle Mark, Aqua Glass - produced after Armstrong's 1938 acquisition of Whitall Tatum
Armstrong T.W. Smoky/Clear Glass - industrial clear glass with age-appropriate tinting and molded date codes
Additional assorted aqua and clear pressed glass insulators to complete the 12-piece set
Condition:
The lot is in good vintage condition consistent with outdoor industrial use. Several pieces show characteristic rust staining near the thread interior and top grooves from contact with metal mounting brackets. No significant structural cracks observed. Minor fleabites and surface scratches may be present on rims or skirts. All molded lettering remains legible.

Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces

Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

description:
Parker Pen Company
Stainless Steel Pen and Pencil Set
Jotter Series, Vintage
This Parker Jotter writing set includes a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, both featuring the classic brushed stainless steel finish and signature arrow clips. Introduced in 1954, the Jotter series became an icon of functional Mid-Century design, praised for its streamlined profile and reliable push-button mechanism. This set is presented in its original black and white pinstriped Parker branding box.
Stainless steel barrel construction with polished chrome-tone accents
Signature Parker arrow pocket clips and top-actuated push-button mechanisms
Set includes one ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil with original display box
Parker and Jotter branding visible on both the instruments and the packaging
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Both writing instruments appear structurally sound with no significant dents or scratches visible on the metal barrels. The clips are tight and aligned. The push-button mechanisms are intact. The original box shows light shelf wear and minor scuffing to the exterior surfaces, but remains structurally complete and holds the pieces securely.

Sheaffer
Lady Sheaffer Fountain Pen - Gold-Tone Brushed Finish
Vintage (Circa 1958-1960s), 1 Pen with Case
This Lady Sheaffer fountain pen represents the intersection of mid-century fashion and high-quality craftsmanship from one of America's most prestigious pen manufacturers. Part of the "Skripsert" line launched in the late 1950s, these pens were designed specifically as stylish accessories for women, often featuring clip-less designs or refined jewelry-like finishes. This specific example features a sophisticated brushed gold-tone finish complemented by an intricate, ornate engraved band on the cap, showcasing the brand's commitment to both utility and style during the peak of fountain pen production.
"Lady Sheaffer" branding clearly visible on the interior lid of the original case
Distinctive brushed metal body with an ornate floral scroll engraved band on the cap
Includes original blue textured hard shell case with satin-lined interior
Accompanied by the internal metal cartridge sleeve/converter housing
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The brushed metal finish shows light age-appropriate surface wear and minor tarnish consistent with use. The ornate cap band remains well-defined. The nib is present and appears straight, though the pen is currently untested for ink flow. The original case shows light exterior wear and storage dust; the hinge functions correctly and the interior lining is intact.

For further explanation of FedEx fees & shipping policies follow the link below:
https://www.fedex.com/content/dam/fedex/us-united-states/services/Fees_Shipping_Information.pdf

4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
The items purchased are all from Youngstown Area Goodwill.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
3 items or less with a combined shipping weight that does not exceed 20 pounds.
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry as some exceptions may be made.
7. Youngstown Area Goodwill will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with the carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.

Items that can safely be combined in the same box may be done at the time of payment. These items are not blocked from combining. description: This lot contains assorted rough petrified wood and raw geode stone specimens. The collection features fossilized wood pieces with visible grain structure and coloration from beige to brown. Included are geode-like specimens with crystalline interiors composed of quartz or chalcedony. The stones vary in size, ranging from small to medium hand specimens. All pieces are in natural, unpolished condition with rough, uneven surfaces showing mineral textures and fossilized patterns. Ideal for collectors, educational purposes, or lapidary projects. No brand or model, as these are natural geological specimens.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Also included are polished agate geode bookends with blue, gray, and white banding.

- Clear quartz cluster
- Selenite tower
- Dendritic or moss agate rough specimen

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

description:
Scotch EG T-120 VHS Tape Lot - 49 Tapes
Blank Media - VHS Format
Late 1980s/Early 1990s Era
This massive lot features 49 original Scotch EG T-120 videocassettes, a staple of the home recording era produced by 3M. Known for their "Everyday Use" reliability, these tapes were designed for recording television series, movies, and home videos with a clear signal-to-noise ratio and a lifetime warranty. Finding a bulk quantity of these classic American-made tapes in factory-sealed condition is increasingly rare for media collectors and analog enthusiasts.
49 Factory-sealed videocassettes (T-120 format)
Standard Grade for everyday recording needs
Made in the USA by 3M Consumer Video and Audio Products
Recording Time: 2 hours (SP), 4 hours (LP), 6 hours (EP/SLP)
Condition:
All 49 tapes are in New In Packaging (NIP) condition, remaining factory sealed in their original clear plastic wrap. The protective cardboard sleeves are well-preserved with sharp corners and vibrant graphics, showing only negligible signs of shelf wear from long-term storage. All units are unused and pristine.

Amber Art
Natural Agate Slice Wall Art Lot
Agate Slices on Fabric-Wrapped Board
22.5" x 10.75" Max Dimensions
Unsigned
This collection features three contemporary wall art pieces showcasing the natural crystalline beauty of dyed agate geodes. Produced by Amber Art, the set includes one large blue agate composition on an unframed linen board, one purple agate composition in a silver-tone frame, and a trio of green agate slices in a dark wood-finish frame. These pieces reflect a modern organic aesthetic, blending geological specimens with minimalist presentation for a sophisticated interior design accent.
Features natural geode slices with vibrant blue, purple, and deep forest green hues
Backgrounds consist of neutral linen-textured fabric for a refined, organic feel
Silver-tone and dark wood-textured frames include white gallery-style matting
Original manufacturing labels indicate a 2020 production period
Condition:
Very good condition. The natural stone slices are securely mounted without visible damage. Frames exhibit minor surface wear and small corner scuffs. The unframed blue piece shows light edge fraying on the fabric wrap. Backing material and hanging hardware are intact.

description:
Condition:
This product is untested and functionality is not verified. This vintage Medico Churchwarden pipe shows signs of previous use consistent with its age. The briar bowl has a developed cake and carbon buildup inside from previous smoking sessions. The exterior wood finish remains relatively smooth with an attractive grain, showing only light surface marks and minor handling wear. The long black stem is intact but exhibits some light tooth chatter near the bit, and the white decorative logo is partially faded. The metal band is secure and adds a nice decorative touch to the transition between shank and stem.
This classic Medico Churchwarden tobacco pipe features the characteristic long, elegant stem that provides a cooler smoke. The shank is clearly stamped with "MEDICO" and "Churchwarden." Crafted from quality briar wood, the bowl features a traditional shape and a warm finish that highlights the natural grain. Perfect for a collector or enthusiast of vintage smoking accessories.
Brand: Medico
Style: Churchwarden
Material: Briar Wood, Metal Band
Long stem design for cooler smoke

description:
Golden Healer Quartz Polished Specimen
Natural Crystal Flame Carving
Polished Stone, 7 Inches, 2.28 Pounds
A striking specimen of Golden Healer Quartz, characterized by its warm honey and amber hues resulting from natural iron oxide inclusions. This piece has been expertly carved into a flame-inspired freeform shape and polished to a high-gloss finish, highlighting the intricate internal veining, banding, and crystalline structures. These specimens are highly prized by mineral collectors and enthusiasts of natural stone decor for their vibrant coloration and organic aesthetic.
Hand-polished Golden Healer Quartz featuring characteristic yellow and golden-orange limonite staining
Carved flame silhouette with a flat-ground base for stable upright display
Displays natural internal fractures, phantoms, and inclusions typical of authentic quartz specimens
Dimensions: 7 inches x 4 inches x 2.5 inches; Weight: 2.28 lbs
Condition:
The stone surface is smooth with a brilliant luster. Natural surface-reaching fissures and deep internal inclusions are present, which are characteristic of natural quartz and are not considered defects. The base is stable and flat. No significant post-polishing chips or impact damage observed on the carved edges or points.
